title: scEPS single-cell disease-neighborhood statistics — clean-room reimpl of Genentech/sceps. Integrates GWAS (MAGMA Z) + single-cell atlas; per-neighborhood variance-component d-statistic (GWAS vs matched control genes). Subcommands: estimate. Runs under the scEPS env (scanpy/anndata/statsmodels).
summary: scEPS — single-cell Expression exPlainability Statistics (IGVFagent port).
